title: Follower goal is flat: 157 vs a required 2.5/day (0.08x trajectory), and the review brain is in cooldown until 2026-09-23
evidence: goal 1: 151 -> 1000 by 2027-08-20; latest snapshot 157 (2026-09-20 00:03Z, 901 snapshots since 2026-08-21) = +6 in 30 days vs 2.52/day required; ratio 0.08. Publishing ran 1-8/day Aug 30-Sep 9, then ZERO posts Sep 10-17 (queue empty, no scheduled_at rows in that window), resumed Sep 18 at 4/day. growth:review_strategy last_reviewed_at 2026-09-16, review_interval_days 7 -> next 2026-09-23.

notes.note: 2026-09-20 07:5xZ ops-triage: the strategy layer's BLINDNESS is fixed this run (root cause found, not the metric). Growth::WeeklyReview aggregates engagement_rate per pillar to steer hashtags/content, but insights had not been collected since 2026-05-27 -- nothing invoked CollectPostInsights (no rake task, no cron) and its selection had no ORDER BY, so even manual runs re-refreshed the same 25 oldest rows. Fixed and verified in production: newest insights write 2026-05-27 -> 2026-09-20 07:45Z, and the FIRST real numbers for recent posts are now visible: 09-18/09-19 posts reach=1-4 (0 likes, 0 comments, 0 saves), 09-06..09-09 posts reach=11-13 (0 likes). So the flat 157 followers is not only a volume ceiling (3/day already at cap) -- per-post REACH has collapsed to 1-4 accounts. That is a new, measurable content/audience signal for the 09-23 review, and a candidate explanation the board could not previously see. Still Tim's call: which lever (content/format/audience vs volume). The insights path now has a probe check (insights-stale) so it can never go silent for months again.
